# Island Safaris Mergui | Small-group island expeditions

> Explore the Mergui Archipelago aboard MV Sea Gipsy. Choose a shared cruise or charter the boat exclusively for a group of up to 10 guests.

## Pages
- [Home page](https://islandsafari.com/en-US) (en-US): Explore the Mergui Archipelago aboard MV Sea Gipsy. Choose a shared cruise or charter the boat exclusively for a group of up to 10 guests.
- [About Myanmar](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/about-myanmar) (en-US): An introduction to Myanmar, its cultural heritage and southern coast, with links to Mergui Archipelago journeys and practical trip planning.
- [About Island Safaris](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/about) (en-US): Explore the Mergui Archipelago with Island Safaris, using MV Sea Gipsy as your base between island stops.

- [Contact](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/contact) (en-US): Your Mergui Archipelago journey can start with a date, a favourite island photograph or simply a wish to spend a few days on the water.
- [Dawei (Tavoy)](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/dawei-tavoy) (en-US): Discover the regional background of Dawei, formerly Tavoy, with town heritage, nearby coastal scenery and clearly marked travel information for review.
- [Shared departure](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/departure) (en-US): Explore the selected Mergui cruise, its itinerary, price and next enquiry step.
- [Departures](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/departures) (en-US): Travel as a couple and share the journey with a small group aboard MV Sea Gipsy.

- [Ten days in the Mergui Archipelago](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/itinerary-10-days) (en-US): Set aside more time for the islands on our longest journey aboard MV Sea Gipsy.
- [Four days in the Mergui Archipelago](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/itinerary-4-days) (en-US): Explore Say Tan Kyun, Cock's Comb and Horse Shoe Island on a four-day Mergui package with one hotel night and two nights aboard MV Sea Gipsy.
- [Five days in the Mergui Archipelago](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/itinerary-5-days) (en-US): Give yourself another day among the southern islands, with three nights aboard MV Sea Gipsy.
- [Six days in the Mergui Archipelago](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/itinerary-6-days) (en-US): Explore island bays and mangrove scenery on a six-day journey aboard MV Sea Gipsy.
- [Kawthaung - Ranong](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/kawthaung-ranong) (en-US): Discover Kawthaung and Ranong, the gateway towns for an Island Safaris cruise, with arrival planning and sightseeing information for review.
- [Explore the Mergui Archipelago](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/mergui-archipelago) (en-US): Forested islands rise above the Andaman Sea, with sandy bays, rocky shores and mangrove waterways along their edges.
- [Moken communities](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/moken-communities) (en-US): Learn about Moken communities and their relationship with the Mergui Archipelago, with guidance on respectful visits and information for client review.
- [Myanmar eVisa application guide](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/myanmar-e-visa) (en-US): Step-by-step Myanmar eVisa guide for MV Sea Gipsy guests entering via Kawthaung. Check documents, processing times, re-entry rules, and onward travel tips.
- [Myeik (Mergui)](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/myeik-mergui) (en-US): An introduction to Myeik, also known as Mergui, its maritime history, waterfront and architecture, with regional travel details for client review.
- [News & Stories](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories) (en-US): Travel stories, archive reports and press coverage of Island Safaris and journeys through the Mergui Archipelago.
- [Now is the time to book a trip to this long-lost island](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/by-joe-cummings) (en-US): Joe Cummings explores the island region and the early development of places to stay offshore. An archive account, not a guide to current resort availability.
- [Real Life](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/by-keith-lyons-jan-2018) (en-US): An account of travelling off the grid aboard Sea Gipsy, with island beaches, shared life on deck and time away from everyday connections.
- [New dawn for remote Andaman Sea island tourism](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/by-keith-lyons-nov-2018) (en-US): Keith Lyons examines 2018 island tourism and development. Note: conditions and arrangements have changed since the original publication date.
- [Sailing among Myanmar's islands of mystery](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/by-miki-meek-mar-2013) (en-US): Miki Meek recounts a six-day voyage with friends and family among the islands.
- [On board MV Sea Gipsy](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/on-board-mv-sea-gipsy) (en-US): A look at life aboard Sea Gipsy and journeys through the Mergui Archipelago.
- [Secret cave joins Myanmar tours](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/secret-cave-joins-tours) (en-US): An archive report on a cave excursion in southern Myanmar, separate from the island cruise itineraries.
- [Exploring the Mergui Archipelago with Thomas Schmid](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/news-stories/thomas-schmid-2019) (en-US): A journalist's account of a journey among the islands, preserved with the original author credit and the later editorial context shown on the existing website.
- [Plan your trip](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/plan-your-trip) (en-US): A little preparation helps you choose the right journey and arrive knowing what to expect.
- [Privacy Policy](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/privacy-policy) (en-US): Privacy Policy draft for client review. Not approved for publication.
- [Private Mergui Archipelago charters](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/private-charters) (en-US): Make MV Sea Gipsy the base for your own group's journey through the Mergui Archipelago.
- [MV Sea Gipsy](https://islandsafari.com/en-US/sea-gipsy) (en-US): Wake aboard MV Sea Gipsy, with the islands outside your curtained sleeping gazebo and another day on the water ahead.
